regulationTopic: Schedule H1 Mandatory Rx Register & Separate Audit Mandate
regulatoryAuthority: CDSCO / Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
controlledDrugsIncluded: 3rd/4th Gen Cephalosporins, Carbapenems, Fluoroquinolones, Macrolides (Azithromycin 500), Zolpidem, Alprazolam
operationalRequirements: Mandatory Rx record with Prescriber Name, Patient Name, Dispensed Qty, Batch and 3-Year Record Retention. Warning box in Red outline on outer carton.
complianceStatus: Active Enforced Standard in Tamil Nadu & All States

regulationTopic: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM 2022) Alignment
regulatoryAuthority: Standing National Committee on Medicines (SNCM) / MoHFW
controlledDrugsIncluded: 384 Medicines spanning 27 Therapeutic Categories including Anti-infectives, Cardiovascular, Oncology, Endocrine
operationalRequirements: Automatic inclusion in Schedule-I of DPCO 2013 for NPPA price ceiling cap regulation.

gazetteNotification: Section 26A Drugs & Cosmetics Act Gazette Notifications (344+ FDCs prohibited)
controlledDrugsIncluded: Nimesulide + Paracetamol dispersible in pediatric, Analgin combinations, Metformin + Atorvastatin, Fixed antimicrobial unapproved combinations
operationalRequirements: Immediate prohibition of manufacture, sale, distribution or stocking. Batches must be recalled immediately.

regulationTopic: Cold Chain Storage & Temperature Monitoring for Biologicals & Vaccines
regulatoryAuthority: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945 (Good Distribution Practices)
gazetteNotification: Rule 64 and Schedule M / Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP)
operationalRequirements: Mandatory 2°C to 8°C continuous refrigeration with calibrated digital temperature logger and daily log book maintenance.
